limitations.quote: I’ll keep dispensing on the rising edge
limitations.note: The defect was the registered output decoder: the outputs needed to respond combinationally to the current state, selection, and reset, but the rewrite retained rising-edge dispensing and changed coin and change handling instead.

limitations.quote: outputs = ((2 if sel else 4) if vend else 0) + (pending > 0)
limitations.note: The test generated expectations from the rewrite’s own credit and change model and checked dispensing only after rising edges, so it could not catch a missing combinational response to a selection change between edges.

limitations.quote: Trace the old and new values of the state, output buffers, visible outputs, and timer on each edge
limitations.note: The agent read relevant advice about tracing FSM output timing, but the record shows no such trace before it decided to keep the outputs registered.
